name: Dalmand (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Dalmand (a blue shield with a white horse and yellow stars) within a green wreath, above a yellow scroll inscribed DALMAND.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Dalmand arms with wreath and scroll
